captions.text: Hi, this is Nobikos, your team's knowledge base. Ask me anything about what I can do.
Hi. What can you actually do for my team?

I help your team find the right person and their reasoning in seconds instead of a day of asking around. Here's how: I pick up the decisions people make in their AI sessions, like Claude or Copilot, and keep only what matters: the choice they made and why, in their own words. Then when someone asks a question in Slack, I tell them who knows it and their reason, so you get answers fast and your team learns from each other without writing documentation.
And how do you learn all that without anyone writing documentation?

I work from the work people already do. When someone uses Claude or Copilot, I capture their AI sessions in the background, just the decisions and reasoning, never the raw chat. Then when a colleague corrects something, decides on an approach, or explains why in a thread, that counts as knowledge. If nobody's written an answer down, I show the closest related facts and tag the person most likely to know, so their reply becomes the answer for next time. Nobody has to sit down and document anything.
What happens when nobody knows the answer?

I show the closest related facts and tag the colleague most likely to know based on what's nearby in the knowledge base. Their reply in the thread becomes a fact under their name, so the next person who asks gets the answer straight away. It's how gaps turn into learning moments for your whole team.
You're welcome! Feel free to reach out anytime you want to know more about how Nobikos can help your team. Take care!
